Class Observation

java.lang.Object
jwat.Observation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Object>
public class Observation extends Object implements Comparable<Object>
This class represents a single observation retrieved from a log file. Every element is a double number that represents either the true value or the converted value representing a string, date or other types.
Author:
Brambilla Davide matr 667986, Fumagalli Claudio 667971
